Corroboration: 1922 Tours Mame, printed p. 157 (artifact PDF p. 271), text layer, lines 23006-23016: 21 of 21 tokens match exactly or in orthography, 0 word-level difference(s).

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Caelestis doni benedictione percepta: supplices te, Deus omnipotens,
deprecamur; ut hoc idem nobis et sacramenti causa sit, et salutis. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.
